svg.title: Every fault happens once
svg.desc: Fleet learning, measured in a live run. A heal fails on sim-1 and holds on sim-3. A Naïve agent session (fleet-doctor) reads both runs in 22 s for 3 cents and writes a skill. The gate replays it, runs a canary on sim-2 for 32.5 s, and promotes it: harness v2 on every arm, 57 s from lesson to fleet, 0 human clicks. Changes that touch safety are staged for their owner instead.
